verse: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.”
story: Joseph is troubled and half decided to quietly end an engagement when an angel tells him what the child's name must be.

The name Jesus is a form of Joshua, meaning the LORD saves, and the angel says exactly how: He will save His people from their sins. The problem Joseph might have expected Him to solve was Rome, but the problem named is sin, deeper than any empire. The child conceived by the Holy Spirit and born of Mary comes as Savior first, before He comes as anything else.
Say the name Jesus slowly this morning, and remember what it was given to Him to mean.
theme: Advent: waiting, promise, the coming King
